page_title: FUL 0-2 CRY | Fulham v Crystal Palace 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+7' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Fulham force a corner. They send men into the box.

90+5' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
90+5' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
90+3' Fulham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Will Hughes will be replaced by Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace).
90' Substitution. Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) has come on for Eberechi Eze.
89' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
86' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
83' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
81' Substitution. Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) on for Jefferson Lerma.
80' The substitution is prepared. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alex Iwobi.
80' It is time for a substitution. Willian (Fulham) is on for Tom Cairney.
80' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Issa Diop (Fulham) replacing Timothy Castagne.
75' The game has come to an end for Ismaila Sarr. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace).

75' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Raul Jimenez (Fulham) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes well past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.

72' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Bernd Leno is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
69' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) for a tough tackle.
69' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
66' 0 - 2 Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Bernd Leno with a strike into the top right corner. He makes it 0:2.
64' Crystal Palace take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

61' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
61' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
60' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
58' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Crystal Palace due to an offside in the build-up play.
58' Here is a change. Sander Berge is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Tom Cairney (Fulham).
58' Marco Silva is forced to make a change. Emile Smith Rowe is unable to continue due to injury, Andreas Pereira (Fulham) comes on.
57' The Crystal Palace players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
56' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He fires the ball into the top left corner.
55' Wonderful movement by Crystal Palace. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
53' The game is interrupted now, Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
50' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes the corner which is cleared.
50' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
49' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.
47' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
46' Referee Robert Jones blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
44' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
40' Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
37' 0 - 1 Joachim Andersen (Fulham) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
37' Corner kick. Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is ready to send the ball into the box.
36' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes a short corner kick.

36' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
33' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fires the resultant free kick towards the left post, but the keeper makes a brilliant save and denies him the chance to score.
32' Robert Jones interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
31' Crystal Palace seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
28' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
27' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

26' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
24' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) swings in a cross from the corner, but Bernd Leno reads it well and gathers the ball.
22' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sander Berge (Fulham) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
20' Fulham are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.

18' Adama Traore (Fulham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Fulham have a corner.
18' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

15' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Crystal Palace are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
13' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
10' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
10' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alex Iwobi (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.

9' Fulham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
7' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
6' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
5' Adama Traore (Fulham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Fulham win a corner.

4' What a huge chance for Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
2' Fulham showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. It's a throw-in for Fulham.
